name: Nice Sugar sprinkled coconut biscuits
ingredients: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), SUGAR, REFINED PALM OIL, SPRINKLED SUGAR (4.7 %), DESICCATED COCONUT (3.8 %), INVERT SYRUP, MILK SOLIDS, RAISING AGENTS [INS 503 (ii), INS 500 (ii)], IODIZED SALT, EMULSIFIERS [INS 471, INS 322(i)] AND ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES (COCONUT, MILK).
